SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary, part of Safety Suggested Vocabulary Safe, danger, needle, bottle, stones ,pain, hurt, bl in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is developed as they practise pronouncing words that contain target sounds.

● Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is promoted as they pronounce words with the target

sounds correctly.

Values:
Unity: A learner works collaboratively in groups and show respect for each other’s opinions.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner applies the skills of correct pronunciation to the learning of similar concept in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested learning resources

• Textbooks in print and in braille

• Audio recording

• Digital devices with assistive technology
